gloss: visitor (to a sick or hospitalized person)

definitions.gloss: visitor to a sick or hospitalized person; well-wisher
definitions.explanation: A person who visits someone who is ill, injured, or hospitalized to offer sympathy and encouragement. Visiting the sick (お{見舞|みま}い) is an important social custom in Japan.

examples.japanese: {見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えなかった→絶える：13814_taeru⟧。
examples.english: There was a steady stream of visitors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}{外|がい}→時間外：26570_jikangai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We do not accept visitors outside of visiting hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}している→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れて→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧や⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きて⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Visitors come every day to see my hospitalized grandmother, bringing flowers and fruit.

notes:
Composed of {見舞|みまい} (visiting the sick/expressing sympathy) + ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest/visitor). Visiting someone in the hospital is a deeply rooted social obligation in Japan, and visitors typically bring gifts such as flowers, fruit, or money in a special envelope.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: visitors come
- {見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧: visitors keep coming (said admiringly)
- {見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to decline visitors
- {見舞客|みまいきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧: hospital visitation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧: hospital visit; sick call — the act of visiting
- ⟦{見舞金|みまいきん}→見舞金：24434_mimaikin⟧: monetary gift for a sick person — money given in an envelope during a visit
- ⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧: meeting; visitation — the general term for visiting someone in a hospital or institution
